Get the team's copy from its secret store, or start from this one; `npm run creds:check [-- <env>]` lists the names the suites, test-data and roles need that an env has no value for (never a value). `accounts`: login and password side by side — a named account (USER) is what suites call {{USER_EMAIL}} / {{USER_PASSWORD}} (or the names in its `vars`); one keyed by its login is a seeded fixture whose password { "use": NAME } is a shared one. `role`: user (storefront) or admin (back office), optional. `shared`: passwords many accounts use. The top level is every env; `envs.<env>` beats it (`<env>` = the env's name, as in its .env.<env> file — replace it, or the loader refuses the file) (an account field by field; "" unsets a shared one). `master`: the one password of every PASSWORDS=master stand. Tokens and API keys never go here (vc-secrets), nor a person's own tracker / code-host login (JIRA_*, GITHUB_*: .env.local). Seeders record every account they create.
